assertions.source: leading ε^6 of -2·b³·ℏ_q^6 at q=1+ε is -2·b³(q=1) = -3√3/4 ≈ -1.299

assertions.name: eps6_value_is_NOT_neg_2
assertions.source: F_3 ε^6 leading equals -2·b³(q=1) = -3√3/4 not -2. PR #664's 'c_3 = J_Hopf(q=1) = -2' is a DIFFERENT object (the textbook writhe-corrected Jones polynomial value), not the order-ε^6 leading of F_3.

description: Consistency check on the c_3 = -2·b³(q=1) = -2 chain via symbolic order-ε^6 extraction from F_3 = 1 - 2b³·ℏ_q^6. Ports PR #661's c_2 = b² methodology. NOTE — does NOT derive F_3 = 1 - 2b³ℏ_q^6 from QOU axioms; that step (PR #657 Track-C, also hand-waved in PR #664) remains the open upstream derivation.
caveats: This probe is a CONSISTENCY check on F_3 = 1 - 2b³ℏ_q^6, not a derivation of F_3 itself. The categorical derivation of the order-h^6 factor of Q_β is the open upstream work (referenced in PR #657 Track-C and hand-waved in PR #664). Genuine closure would require: (a) building V_(2,1) ⊗ V_(2,1) Schur-Weyl in H_6, (b) projecting onto V_(2,2,2), (c) computing the Hopf-channel contribution at order h^6, (d) verifying no other channel contributes.

Per docs/audits/2026-05-17-dual-tr-m-discrepancy.md, the QOU canonical Markov trace tr_Markov_symbolic(σ_1²) at q=1 gives +1, not -2. The -2 value here comes from the textbook writhe-corrected Jones polynomial -(q+q⁻¹) at q=1. The writhe-correction step is also part of the upstream open work.
